parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description:
Personal access token.  
This field is not required when using Alibaba Cloud AccessKey ID and AccessKey Secret or temporary authorization via Security Token Service (STS).

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string form. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
